provenance.labels: solveCommunity community-static-v5 synthetic labels; predictors use source arithmetic and learned residuals, no inverse call.
provenance.split: 320 new setting triples: hash(accuracy-v3:key)%10 0–1 test, 2 calibration, 3 validation, 4–9 train. All scopes/goals/flags stay grouped. Another 80 triples form shared interior/exterior challenge groups.
provenance.selection: Capacity chosen using validation only. Final refit train+validation; calibration and tests excluded.
provenance.reevaluation: Initial scores were viewed before a converter tie-correctness fix. Same fixed ML design rerun on corrected labels; no test-driven ML tuning. Reserved from fitting, not a pristine one-shot evaluation.
provenance.priorSets: All 196 prior setting groups excluded. Prior test/challenge results are observed regressions, not fresh evidence.
provenance.scope: Fidelity to a declared reconstruction only. Designed synthetic groups do not establish exchangeability or native coverage.
provenance.emptyShapeConvention: Two empty masks count as rendered equality/IoU1 for fidelity only, never rendering evidence.
